concept: Exploring a topic or interest outside your usual comfort zone or social group
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is presented with a topic outside their usual interests and social identity, and a believable social-pressure reason to avoid engaging with it
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to explore it anyway
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what held them back and what pulled them forward

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific internal or social barrier to exploring outside their comfort zone
